metadata.title: High-Contrast Monochrome Portrait with Script Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white portrait of a male figure against a pure white background. The subject is lit with dramatic side-lighting that leaves half the face in deep shadow, wearing a dark textured sweater. A casual, thin-stroke handwritten script is positioned in the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark silhouette against a void-like white background
Extreme chiaroscuro lighting defining facial structure
Contrast between the rigid photographic realism and the organic handwritten text
Texture of the knit sweater versus the smooth skin and flat background
coreInvariants: Deep, crushed blacks with no detail in shadows
Subject looking directly at the camera with a downward tilt

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally framed upper torso and head, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's lit eye and the bridge of the nose.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the intense gaze, follows the vertical line of the nose down to the dark sweater, then moves to the white script in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Pure white negative space surrounds the head and shoulders, creating a sharp cutout effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between 0% and 100% brightness.
paletteRestrictions: No subtle gradients in the background

letterConstructionRules: Thin, uniform stroke weight as if written with a fine-liner pen
Connected letters in a casual, non-formal script style
Lowercase dominance with occasional upright capitals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single organic script style to contrast the geometric sharpness of the portrait silhouette.

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the personal, intimate feel of the original lettering.
Provides a clean but human touch that fits the minimalist aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a young man with short textured hair, wearing a black knit sweater. Use harsh side-lighting to create deep shadows on one side of the face. Place against a seamless, blown-out white background. Apply a subtle film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of white, thin-stroke handwritten script in the bottom right corner, overlapping the dark area of the sweater. The text should look like natural, casual penmanship.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with no shadows?
Is the text legible but appearing hand-drawn?
Is the contrast high enough that shadow details are lost?
Is the grain texture consistent across the subject?

adjustableVariables: Specific line breaks of the script
Amount of shadow coverage on the face
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Any existing logos or advisory stickers
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is white and placed over the dark sweater area.
Check that the subject's gaze is intense and directed forward.
Verify the image is strictly monochrome with no color cast.
Confirm the background is a flat, solid white.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + harsh side-lighting + white negative space + lower-right organic script overlay.
